originalTitle: ICICI Bank Q1 Results: Profit jumps 16% YoY to Rs 14,805 crore; NII rises 13% as margins expand
simplifiedContent: ICICI Bank just released its first-quarter results, and they're looking good. The bank's profit increased by 16% compared to the same time last year, reaching Rs 14,805 crore. This is largely because the bank earned more from interest on loans, with its net interest income growing by 13%. The bank's overall performance was strong, with improvements in the quality of its assets and growth in loans and deposits. This is a positive sign for the bank and its investors, indicating that the bank is doing well financially.

originalTitle: HDFC Bank Q1 Results: Net profit rises 5% YoY to Rs 19,060 crore, NII up 7%
simplifiedContent: HDFC Bank just released its financial results for the first quarter of the year, and its profit increased by 5% compared to the same time last year, reaching Rs 19,060 crore. The bank also made more money from interest on loans, with a 7% increase. This is a good sign for the bank, and its overall financial health looks stable. The bank's results were a bit better than what some experts at Nomura expected, but not as good as what others at Kotak predicted. Overall, the bank's stable financial performance is a positive sign for investors.

originalTitle: Bitcoin rebounds to $64K after AI-led selloff triggers crypto rout. Here's what experts say
simplifiedContent: The price of Bitcoin, a type of digital money, had dropped below $63,000 due to a big sell-off caused by artificial intelligence systems. However, it then rebounded back up to around $64,000. This happened because some investors were feeling cautious and selling their cryptocurrencies, but a positive report on US inflation, which showed that prices weren't rising as fast as expected, helped to calm them down and regain confidence. Despite this rebound, experts think that the overall trend of Bitcoin's price is still heading downwards. This means that while the price may have gone back up a bit, it could still potentially keep falling.

originalTitle: IPO GMP Check: SBI Funds Management IPO vs Alpine Texworld IPO - What grey market signals ahead of listings?
simplifiedContent: Two companies, SBI Funds Management and Alpine Texworld, recently finished their initial public offering (IPO) process, where they sold shares to the public. SBI Funds Management did very well, with many people wanting to buy its shares, and its "grey market premium" (a measure of how much people are willing to pay extra for the shares) was ₹91. In contrast, Alpine Texworld didn't do as well, with fewer people interested in its shares and a much lower grey market premium of ₹1. This suggests that SBI Funds Management's shares might perform better when they start trading on the stock market. The strong demand for SBI Funds Management shares, with 41.66 times subscription, also indicates a positive start for the company on the stock market.

originalTitle: ICICI Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit rises 16% to  ₹14,804.50 crore
simplifiedContent: ICICI Bank just released its quarterly results, which show that the bank made a profit of ₹14,804.50 crore. This is a 16% increase from the same time last year, when the bank made a profit of ₹12,768.21 crore. The bank announced these results on July 18, 2026. This matters because it shows that the bank is doing well and making more money than it did last year. Overall, this increase in profit is a positive sign for the bank and its investors.

originalTitle: Yes Bank Q1 results 2026: Net profit jumps 33.7% YoY, operating profit up 25.5%
simplifiedContent: Yes Bank just released its financial results for the first quarter of 2026, which covers the months of April to June. The bank's net profit, or the amount of money it made, was ₹1,071 crore, which is 33.7% higher than it was during the same time last year. This is a significant increase and a good sign for the bank's performance. The bank's operating profit also went up by 25.5%, which indicates that its core business is doing well. This increase in profit is important because it shows that Yes Bank is growing and performing better than it was in the past.
